prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent PNG decorative background for the lower part of a narrow project sidebar in an AI development workbench; displayed approximately 240 by 310 CSS pixels.
Primary request: Create one standalone atmospheric illustration using ONLY the orderly repeated thin transparent planes seen at the lower left of reference image 1. They suggest archive leaves and project organization abstractly.
Input images: Image 1 is a composition and form reference, ONLY its lower-left layered planar decoration; ignore all UI, text, other decorations, cards and content. Image 2 is a pastel gradient colour/material reference, particularly its first panel repeated sheets.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with actual alpha, no white rectangle, no checkerboard drawn in the image.
Subject: seven to nine extremely thin flat parallel vertical planes, aligned and gently offset in a disciplined stepped rhythm. The repeated planes are seen at a shallow oblique angle, with little thickness; light passes through their broad faces. Similar to abstract archived sheets rather than literal folders.
Composition/framing: portrait approx 768 by 1024. A compact ordered cluster occupies the lower-right area and extends down to the bottom. Leave upper and left portions transparent and spacious. All outer colour fades smoothly to transparency. The illustration needs to sit underneath sidebar text as an ambient background without taking any layout space.
Style/medium: refined airy translucent gradient illustration; restrained soft optical refraction. Keep the source image's parallel repeated sheet geometry, not a new sculpture.
Color palette: shallow cyan and light blue fading through lilac, pink coral, pale apricot yellow and mint. Light colours with delicate chroma and transparent overlapping gradients; no grey monochrome.
Materials/textures: paper-thin translucent film, luminous but subtle, feathered disappearing margins, tiny light rim only, no hard edge silhouette, no strong shadow, no solid extruded panels.
Text: none.
Constraints: background layer only, low visual weight, no UI elements, no letters, no icons, no marks. Keep high transparency and soft gradient fade especially along top and left of the cluster.
Avoid: pearls, spheres, jewellery, literal chips, hardware, electronics, graph nodes, connector dots, arrows, thick books, folder icons, solid blocks, strong outlines, sharp coloured borders, dark shadows, watermarks.
notes: Standalone ordered archive-plane ambient decoration for sidebar bottom. Transparent pixels and graded alpha preserved. Intended below text, absolute positioning, pointer-events none; visual opacity and feathering controlled in consuming CSS.
